bayts.text: And spread over me the blessings of the Ants (sūra an-Naml), without affliction, and gather together what is scattered for me.
And spare us contention and turbidity unto the Gardens of eternity, O You Who have power.
And bless, O Judge (Al-Ḥakam), and grant peace upon the chosen Prophet, greeted with peace,
his Family and his Companions; and grant me, by the sūra al-Qaṣaṣ, what turns fear away
toward others than me, and my clinging to glad tidings unto the Gardens of eternity, O Lord of humankind.
And free me, by remembrance (of God), from recalling what has already passed, and illumine my thoughts for me.
And bless, O Just (Al-ʿAdl), with a blessing with peace, him who effaced all blame from me,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me, by the Spider (sūra al-ʿAnkabūt), all that gladdens me, with a sound permanence.
And grant me justice in the outward and the inward, and bestow on me what is pure.
And bless, O Subtle (Al-Laṭīf), O All-Aware (Al-Khabīr), him whose reward is great,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, and the Family and the Companions who dispel the darkness.
And spread over me the blessings of the Byzantines (sūra ar-Rūm), a spreading by which I may be possessed of honour,
without affliction and without turbidity, O Lord of decree, of creation and of predestination.
And for me, by Luqmān, make piety lasting in all things, and spare me delusion.
And bless, O Forbearing (Al-Ḥalīm), O Mighty (Al-ʿAẓīm), him to whom veneration has yielded,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, and the Family and the Companions; and turn darknesses away
toward others than me, and illumine all of me, and with safety and clarity be for me.
And spread over me the blessings of the Prostration (sūra as-Sajda), O You Who lead His glory to the Glorious.
And grant me, by it and by the Confederates (sūra al-Aḥzāb), a worship that rises without (hostile) confederates.
And free us from what necessitates forbearance, with the best deeds and the best knowledge,
and with the neighbourhood of the people of good, O You Who spared us every bearer of harm.
And bless, O Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr), O Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), him whose pre-eminence is mentioned,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, and the Family, the Companions and every Muslim.
And grant me, by Sabaʾ and by Fāṭir, what puts to shame every good obtained by rain.
And spare us fear in the two Abodes, and all that drags to the two disgraces.
And bless, O Most High (Al-ʿAlī), O Great (Al-Kabīr), him to whom the All-Aware gave tidings,
our master Muḥammad, with peace, and the Family and the Companions; and accept this speech from me.
And grant me elevation and greatness, O Everlasting Who have already removed ruin
toward others than me; and make safety lasting for me with good pleasure, and make time clear for me.
And grant me, by the right of Yā Sīn, the wishes, without tremor, and lead the trustworthy to me.
And for me, by the gourd (of Jonah, sūra aṣ-Ṣāffāt 37:146), grant all that I love of righteous deeds that are chosen.
And bless, O Guardian (Al-Ḥafīẓ), O Sustainer (Al-Muqīt), him through whom the (prayer) times are brought to life,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, and the Family and the Companions; and make my pen mighty.
By the right of David (sūra Ṣād) and by the right of the Throngs (sūra az-Zumar), make clear and honour, O Generous, my life.
And bless, O Reckoner (Al-Ḥasīb), O Majestic (Al-Jalīl), him to whom glorification has yielded,
from You, with Your peace — and he is the Chosen — and the Family and the Companions, people of ascent.
By (the sūra) Ghāfir adh-Dhanb, by the right of Fuṣṣilat, and by the sanctity of ash-Shūrā, which unveiled the wishes.
And bless, O Generous (Al-Karīm), O Watchful (Ar-Raqīb), him through whom the chief was raised,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, his Family, his Companions and the learned,
by the sūra az-Zukhruf; and make the poem (accepted and blessed), O You with Whom is what I love of mighty things.
And grant, by the sūra ad-Dukhān, to the Messenger glad tidings that bring him the best request.
And bless, O Answerer (Al-Mujīb), and grant peace upon the intercessor of intercessors, the banner,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
by the sanctity of (the sūra) al-Jāthiya, the venerated, O Subduer to Whom belong loftiness and might.
And bless, O All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ), O Wise (Al-Ḥakīm), him to whom judgement has yielded,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, with the Family, the Companions and whoever submitted (to Islām),
by the sūra al-Aḥqāf and al-Qitāl, O You Who free from what draws adversaries.
And bless, O Loving (Al-Wadūd), O Glorious (Al-Majīd), him to whom glorification has yielded,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, and the Family and the Companions; and teach my heart,
by the sanctity of al-Fatḥ and by the right of al-Ḥujurāt, O You Who free from pain and death-throes.
And bless, O Resurrector (Al-Bāʿith), with peace, the bearer of glad tidings, the known intercessor,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
by the sanctity of the Glorious (sūra Qāf), and make my writing, with You, O Appreciative, the best writing.
And bless, O Witness (Ash-Shahīd), with peace, him whom my pens praise,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
